subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

L, N, P, R, T, V, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a22e849294f30f1c26ce29433dfdc070bc3ce4277a615992ef818dd930b88c5a.png] 

The logic followed here is:

L + 2 = N,

N + 2 = P,

P + 2 = R,

R + 2 = T,

T + 2 = V, 

V + 2 = **X.**

So, 'U' will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
